audit.whatIsWrong: Rated EVEN 5.5/10 while Annie sits at 48.03% over 610 games, and every reference to Naafiri uses male pronouns.
audit.why: Naafiri is a three-mobility-tool assassin (Q dash-leap for packmates, E 450 dash, R 900 lock-on dash) against a 600-range immobile mage. The lane is genuinely uncomfortable pre-6.
audit.corrected: Slightly unfavoured, decided by whether Pyromania is banked when Hounds' Pursuit comes off its 110s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side disagrees with content win[] on four of seven rows, and phases[5].why plus whys[5] and spikes[2] all claim the first-item window for Annie while win[5] says Naafiri.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Skill, Skill, Annie, Annie, Naafiri, Annie]; the content layer already matches it, the full layer does not, and three prose fields argue against their own row.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[3]/[5]/[6].side to Annie/Naafiri/Annie and rewrite the three prose fields so the first-item row reads as Naafiri's lethality-plus-shield spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Naafiri ability is named outside the focus string, and the three untargetable windows are never mentioned.
audit.why: The Call of the Pack (W, 26/24/22/20/18s) and Eviscerate (E, 11/10/9/8/7s) both grant untargetability, and Hounds' Pursuit's second cast grants a shield. Annie's whole kit is single-target point-and-click; spending Q into an untargetable window wastes the banked stun entirely.
audit.corrected: Hold Q through W and E — she is untargetable for those beats — and force the R recast shield out before committing Tibbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is mentioned only as 'his sustain' with no source named.
audit.why: Eviscerate fully heals her packmates and is her sustain in extended trades; Grievous Wounds timing is the itemization decision this matchup actually has.
audit.corrected: Name Eviscerate as the healing to cut.

edits.before: Luden's/Stormsurge spike: the stun-burst math kills through Doran's defenses. Stock, walk forward, win.
edits.after: Her first lethality item plus the Hounds' Pursuit shield beats your burst unless the stun is already banked.

edits.before: Naafiri's ultimate reset and fresh packmates let her punish or escape fights during this specific power spike.
edits.after: Tibbers lands the moment Hounds' Pursuit locks on — Annie's level 6 answers the dive with a stun and a bear.

edits.before: Annie's first item burst combo now consistently kills Naafiri before her dash sequence fully connects.
edits.after: Naafiri's lethality item and the Hounds' Pursuit shield outpace Annie's first-item burst if the stun is spent.

edits.before: Your burst combo now kills her before her dash-heavy combo fully connects, provided you land the stun first.
edits.after: Her first lethality item and the Hounds' Pursuit shield eat your burst — bank Pyromania or you lose the exchange.

edits.before: Naafiri wins by landing Hounds’ Pursuit, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Naafiri wins by bleeding you with Darkin Daggers, then locking on with Hounds' Pursuit while your stun is still rebuilding.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Molten Shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Hounds' Pursuit is her dive and it is down 110s at rank 1 — that whole window she has to walk at you. - The Call of the Pack (26s) and Eviscerate (11s) both go untargetable: hold Q until she reappears. - E for emergencies, R for openings.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry by surviving the dive — Tibbers on your own head answers the pack, then you walk forward and finish her.

edits.before: If Naafiri gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Hounds’ Pursuit extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Naafiri gets a kill, lethality makes the pack lethal — give Hounds' Pursuit extra room and farm it back. Two kills: buy Grievous Wounds early and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.

edits.before: At four stacks: walk forward, Q-stun, W, auto, walk away re-stacking off the wave — a guaranteed chunk he answered with nothing.
edits.after: At four stacks: walk forward, Q-stun, W, auto, walk away re-stacking off the wave — a chunk she can only answer with Eviscerate.

edits.before: Spending the stocked stun on wave-clear with his engage loaded — unstacked Annie is the most killable mage in the lane.
edits.after: Spending the stocked stun on wave-clear with Hounds' Pursuit up — unstacked Annie is the most killable mage here.

edits.before: The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Hounds' Pursuit locks on from 900 and cannot miss — the banked stun is the only thing that answers the arrival. Bank it.

edits.before: At four stacks: walk forward, Q-stun, W, auto, walk away re-stacking off the wave — a guaranteed chunk he answered with nothing.
edits.after: Molten Shield's move speed and its damage-on-hit both fire as the pack lands — shield first, then stun her out of Eviscerate.

edits.before: Naafiri burns Hounds’ Pursuit on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Tibbers' burn hits every packmate at once and she cannot leave the zone mid-dive.

edits.before: That is Naafiri’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Unstacked, her Q bleed and packmates chunk you before you can answer at all.

edits.before: Spending the stocked stun on wave-clear with his engage loaded — unstacked Annie is the most killable mage in the lane.
edits.after: Hounds' Pursuit recasts once and the second cast shields her — chasing that reset walks you into a full-health pack.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's or Stormsurge into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — cast it mid-Tibbers. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's or Stormsurge into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — cast it mid-Tibbers. Add anti-heal early into Eviscerate's healing.
